<!-- pr-reviewer: e5d6553c5c2015ded7e608dcd40163a742594536 -->
**Independent review** (a second reviewer, separate from the author's own checks): **Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- `v_load` (`crates/app/src/script/api.rs:22`) now loads into a fresh `new_world()` and only on success swaps `env.world`, resets `History`, clears `posted` and sets `doc_path`. The old world is dropped as a whole (flecs/Rust-owned components free their cached toolpaths and meshes on drop), so nothing from the previous document survives or leaks, and the double-posting from appending to the live world is gone.
- A failed open (missing/corrupt file) returns before any assignment: document, undo/redo and save destination stay intact.
- The live (GUI-attached) session still refuses `open_project` (`live.rs:22`), and the `Env` there borrows the app's world handle, so the GUI's unsaved-changes prompt is not bypassed; the headless/script `Env::fresh()` session has no such prompt, so "replace" matches the headless semantics.
- Tests (`mcp_open`: repeat open posts one section, empty-file replacement, undo/redo reset, failed-open preservation, script `cam.load`) are in `crates/app/tests`; decision file present. No unwrap/expect/panic added.

**Local results (merged with main a6bd69d8; clean merge)**
- `mcp` 17/17 (incl. the 4 `mcp_open` tests), `mcp_live` 10/10, `mcp_setup` 6/6, `commands_undo` 30/30, `project_roundtrip` 71/71, `scripting` 7/7, `cli` 18/18: all pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (non-blocking)**
- `new_world()` also calls `rest::clear_carried_cache()` (`world.rs:18`), a process-global cache, so a failed open still clears that cache for the kept document. It only costs a recompute, but loading the file before creating the world would be cleaner if it is easy.
- `mcp_open/mod.rs` is the new test dir at ~157 lines: fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
